$comment: Static region tables for capabilities that `az cognitiveservices model list` cannot report. Copied from Microsoft Learn; re-verify when the pages change. Used by Find-FoundryRegion.ps1. 'required' capabilities block provisioning; 'advisory' ones only lower the region score because the app has a local/alternate fallback.

maiVoices.label: MAI voices
maiVoices.fallback: MAI-Voice is also routed globally; otherwise the app uses Kokoro (local) or the optional OpenAI tts deployment.

maiTranscribe.label: MAI-Transcribe
maiTranscribe.fallback: Whisper (local) or the optional OpenAI transcribe deployment (deployOpenAIAudio=true).

contentUnderstanding.label: Content Understanding
contentUnderstanding.fallback: PdfPig, VLM, Document Intelligence or Mistral OCR document paths.

documentIntelligence.label: Document Intelligence
documentIntelligence.fallback: PdfPig, VLM, Content Understanding or Mistral OCR document paths.
documentIntelligence.note: Document Intelligence v4.0 is available in every candidate region; for other regions check products-by-region and add them here.
